cases.surface: The timeline is complete, yet the concrete closing response that was mine is still not identified.
We know the event sequence, but the observable final step attributable to me has not been stated.
The account covers everything except what I myself actually did at the end.
Take the judgement out of my hands and tell me the one choice I am supposed to make.
What hidden judgement is my teammate holding about me beyond anything they have shown outwardly?
Tell me my manager's private assessment of me, not anything based on my own actions.
What secret intention does the other person have toward me when there is no observable sign?
Will this eventually work out in my favour before the end of the month?
Is this situation likely to finish positively for me by the deadline?
A reversible first experiment was available, but I kept expanding the list of alternatives instead of starting.
The low-risk trial was ready, yet I researched more possibilities rather than begin it.
An easy-to-undo move was available, but I stayed uncommitted by gathering more options.
The central task needed a response, but I ignored it and shifted to something peripheral.
My answer came late; after one review I did not reopen the issue.
I delayed my response, looked once more, and then moved on without reopening it.
I approached the move, withdrew, and came back to the same review loop repeatedly without fresh evidence.
